title: 18650/18350 Battery Case
description:
18650/18350 Battery Case
Stay safe with this battery case from Arizer. It is very important that care be taken when carrying and storing batteries. This case will prevent short circuiting and help prevent physical damage if dropped.
This case can hold 2 18650 batteries (length ways) or 4 18350 (width ways)
Included
1 x 18650/18350 Battery case
